newsitem.title: USA: Boy shot, killed outside Florida middle school.
newsitem.headline: Boy shot, killed outside Florida middle school.

text.p: Jean Pierre Camel, 14, was shot and killed outside Conniston Middle School when he refused to give up his wristwatch as he arrived for classes Monday, police and witnesses said.
"He was shot three times in the chest," West Palm Beach police dispatch supervisor Linda Mytych said.
Police found a suspect, another student, in class at the school. The suspect, also 14, was taken into custody for questioning, police said.
Witnesses said the assailant demanded the victim's watch and the two were heard arguing before the shots were fired.
